item.title: Fox News’ past Biden corruption accusations perfectly describe the UAE’s secret investment in Trump’s crypto business
item.description: Fox News has ignored bombshell reports detailing an apparent $500 million quid pro quo scheme involving an Emirati royal’s investment in a Trump family cryptocurrency business in exchange for access to chips used for AI. American national security officials had previously opposed providing access to the chips.
